newsitem.title: USA: Makers of Godzilla film find destruction in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Makers of Godzilla film find destruction in U.S..

text.p: - The makers of a film sequel starring Godzilla -- the benign monster of Japanese films which is part dragon, part dinosaur -- got some unplanned special effects Tuesday.

A suspected tornado blew through the city and left behind a swath of overturned trees and damaged buildings, among them the building where the crew was filming, said Sgt. Andrew Martinez, a city police spokesman. "The whole area is a mess," he said.
The film crew escaped with little more than a scare from broken windows, Martinez said. The National Weather Service has not yet confirmed whether the damage came from a tornado.
